item.title: This week from Bagley: ICE out of Utah, silencing the press, Trump’s lies, global warming, democracy’s demise
item.description: This week's cartoons from The Salt Lake Tribune's Pat Bagley.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa wasn’t really ‘about to pass out’ in BYU’s loss to Houston, but Saturday highlighted a problem for the Cougars
item.description: A lack of depth has become an issue for the Cougars, who have now lost four straight conference games.

item.title: ‘It felt great’: Jaren Jackson Jr. makes successful debut for the Jazz
item.description: The Jazz's trade acquisitions made their debut and looked very promising in doing so — before tanking out the fourth quarter to get a loss. What did Jaren Jackson Jr. say in his debut?

item.title: Breezy Johnson wins gold in women’s downhill, first U.S. medal of Olympics
item.description: Breezy Johnson wins the women's downhill at the Milan Cortina Olympics — the first American to take the gold in that event in 16 years. Her medal is also the first U.S. gold in these games.

item.title: Utah athletes are a big part of ‘the best’ U.S. women’s Alpine team ever. Here’s how they did Sunday.
item.description: Based on top-10 World Cup finishes, this is by far the best World Cup women's Alpine ski team in the history of the United States. Utah athletes, from 41-year-old Lindsey Vonn to 22-year-old Mary Bocock, are key to that success.

item.title: Letter: Maloy and Owens should drop the frivolous lawsuit regarding Utah’s redistricting map
item.description: Letter: Celeste Maloy and Burgess Owens are wasting taxpayer money with their frivolous lawsuit. Why don’t you two go out and earn re-election instead?

item.title: Letter: Mormon Women for Ethical Government’s stand on immigration enforcement opened my eyes to the possibility of a greater coalition
item.description: Letter: I’ve spoken out quite vociferously against the LDS Church, but if we are to succeed in our fight for fair representation, we must embrace allies — like Mormon Women for Ethical Government — where we find them.

item.title: Letter: Aiming to eliminate the Circuit Breaker program, Sen. McCay seems to regard seniors as the ‘undeserving poor’
item.description: Letter: Poor seniors are expected to subsidize vouchers for people buying ski passes, but when we need a little help in turn, forget it? Sen. Dan McCay doesn't seem to think very highly of us seniors.

item.title: Seahawks bully Drake Maye, Patriots on way to dominant Super Bowl LX win
item.description: Seattle's defense dominates, and running back Kenneth Walker III earns MVP honors in the Seahawks' Super Bowl win over the New England Patriots.
